name: Dragon Blade 2
storyline: The story takes place not long after the events of Dragon Blade 1. Our protagonists, Amy and Kyno, stumble upon a hidden sword of legendary power while on a mission. Since word of the sword’s power has spread around the world, everyone wants to get their hands on it. Our heroes soon realize the immense danger they’ve brought upon themselves—and perhaps the entire world—if the sword falls into the wrong hands.
summary: Sequel to a Hungarian RPG Maker game by the team of Ruby Dragon Entertainment. The game was released in 2006, free of cost. The RPG features a turn-based battle system, talent points with new unlockable abilities and a half-serious, half-comedic storytelling.
